results.text: CAM-S1 runs on a rechargeable battery lasting 3 to 6 months. Below 10 percent the camera disables live view and may miss events; below 3 percent it goes offline. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Frequent motion events in busy areas shorten battery life; enable power-saving mode.
Customer reported a CAM-S1 in a detached garage going offline several times a day. RSSI was -86 dBm; all other devices normal. Installing an RP-1 repeater solved it. Resolved at frontline.

Uplink loss of the base station, pairing timeouts, capacity limit reached, weak signal of a single device, low battery, outdated peripheral firmware that upgrades successfully via OTA, and full storage. Provide the customer with step-by-step instructions and confirm the issue is resolved.

[escalation_policy#Close at frontline (L1)] Uplink loss of the base station, pairing timeouts, capacity limit reached, weak signal of a single device, low battery, outdated peripheral firmware that upgrades successfully via OTA, and full storage. Provide the customer with step-by-step instructions and confirm the issue is resolved.

[manual_peripherals#Pairing a peripheral] Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. complaint: Porch camera offline. It said low battery a few days ago, so maybe that's all it is. I don't have much time to deal with this, so please just tell me what to do or send me whatever part I need and I'll swap it myself this weekend.
usability_reason: The response is polite and clear, and it avoids claiming any unperformed checks or fixes. However, it is not actionable: the customer explicitly asked for concrete steps or a replacement part to swap this weekend, but the reply only says engineering will review and contact within 24 hours with no next steps. It also does not address the customer's request for a part, and the suspected root cause is somewhat speculative (battery failure/hardware fault) without evidence beyond the failed charge attempt.
